plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Economics - Business Analytics Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Economics Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Business Analytics Emphasis (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the BS: the catalog prints a single combined line, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the map expressly does not include the BA's 16 credits of one foreign language. The catalog's BS requirement is 12 credits of Math or Science courses (at least 3 credits MATH numbered 1000 or above, excluding MATH 1030 or MATH 1040, and at least 3 credits of Science courses numbered 1000 or above), and the catalog notes a portion of the BS requirement may be met by satisfying General Education requirements; the map does not label BS courses separately. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/15/15/15/15/16/15/13) and the plan to the catalog's printed BA/BS degree total of 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Foundation/Prerequisite block (14-15 credits) is exercised at 14: the map places MATH 1100 Applied Calculus (3 credits) for the block's Complete One of the Following choice (MATH 1100 or MATH 1210 Calculus I, 4 credits), recorded as a choice slot with both catalog options. The Emphasis block (12 credits) reconciles exactly: ANLY 3250, ANLY 4100, ANLY 4110 and ECON 4150 are all placed by the map; the catalog prints the analytics courses as 'ANLY 4100 / ANLY 6100' and 'ANLY 4110 / ANLY 6110', recorded under the undergraduate numbers the map prints. The map's free-elective rows total 54 credits (38 Free Electives + 16 Free Upper-division Electives); the catalog prints no free-elective total, so that figure is the map's as printed. The map's free-elective rows in Years 1-2 carry printed course recommendations (FIN 2870 in Fall Year 1, ACCT 2010 in Spring Year 1, BA 2010 in Fall Year 2), recorded in the slots' notes; the rows themselves are printed as free electives and are recorded as such. DISCLOSED catalog header error, not reconciled: the catalog heads its Core Courses block '21 Credits' but the six courses it lists (ECON 2010, ECON 2020, ECON 3010, ECON 3020, ECON 3150, ECON 4950, 3 credits each) sum to 18, so the itemized curriculum totals 44-45 against the printed Curriculum heading of 47-48; the map places exactly the six listed core courses and reconciles to the printed degree total of 120, so the plan is recorded at 120 with the header error disclosed (the same header-vs-itemized pattern as the collected Rotor-Wing and Biomedical Science plans). Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates (ANLY 3250 Data Management and Organization). GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
